senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חלב) [to be soft, moist, viscous,] to have good humors, to be well. Part. pass. חָלוּם, f. חֲלוּמָה sane, opp. to שוטה; well, opp. to חולה.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:3">Tosef. Ter. I, 3</cite> <he>פעמים … ח׳</he> if one is at times insane, at times sane; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:16">R. Hash. 28ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="H01049"><he>חַלִּים</he></cite> (Ch. form).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:3">Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48ᶜ</cite>.—
